data.one_liner: Access the device light sensor on Android.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for Android allowing access to the device light sensor. It provides methods to check sensor availability and subscribe to a stream of light updates in lux.
use_when: You need to read ambient light sensor data on Android devices.
You want to react to lighting changes in real-time using a lux stream.
avoid_when: You need support for platforms other than Android.
You need cross-platform sensor support like iOS.
strengths: Simple API for checking sensor availability and listening to lux updates.
Actively maintained plugin refreshing the older unmaintained 'light' package.

alternatives.name: sensors_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides cross-platform sensor support including accelerometer, gyroscope, and magnetometer.

final bool hasSensor = await LightSensor.hasSensor();
LightSensor.luxStream().listen((lux) {...});
